description: Estadísticas de Emergencias Atendidas Octubre 2020 | Bomberos is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Benemerito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá. Estadísticas y cuadro comparativo de emergencias atendidas a nivel nacional por el Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de la República de Panamá en el mes de Octubre 2020. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Benemerito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá. Its tags are accidentes, emergencias, incendios. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2022-01-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
